main_sections.title: Understanding Cannabinoids
main_sections.subtitle: Each cannabinoid offers unique effects and benefits. Learn what sets them apart.

content.title: Delta 9 THC
content.subtitle: The Primary Psychoactive Cannabinoid
content.description: Delta 9 THC is the main psychoactive compound in cannabis. Hemp-derived Delta 9 is federally legal when it contains less than 0.3% THC by dry weight. It provides a well-balanced, euphoric experience.

steps.title: Start Low
steps.description: Begin with a low dose (5-10mg) to assess tolerance

steps.title: Wait for Effects
steps.description: Wait 1-2 hours for effects to fully develop

steps.title: Adjust as Needed
steps.description: Gradually increase as needed for your desired experience

content.title: THCA (Tetrahydrocannabinolic Acid)
content.subtitle: The Non-Psychoactive Precursor to THC
content.description: THCA is the raw, non-psychoactive form of THC found in fresh cannabis. When heated (decarboxylated), it converts into Delta 9 THC. THCA products are prized for their potency and purity.

steps.title: Use Compatible Battery
steps.description: Use a compatible 510-thread battery for carts

steps.title: Start Small
steps.description: Start with 1-2 small puffs to gauge potency

steps.title: Allow Time Between Puffs
steps.description: Allow 5-10 minutes between puffs for full effects

content.title: THCP (Tetrahydrocannabiphorol)
content.subtitle: The Most Potent Cannabinoid Available
content.description: THCP is a naturally occurring cannabinoid that is significantly more potent than Delta 9 THC—up to 33 times more active at CB1 receptors. It provides a deep, long-lasting, and intense experience.

steps.title: Extreme Caution
steps.description: THCP is highly potent—start with a very small amount

steps.title: Minimal Dose
steps.description: Take only 1 small puff and wait 15+ minutes

steps.title: Experienced Users Only
steps.description: Only experienced users should use THCP regularly

content.title: CBD (Cannabidiol)
content.subtitle: The Non-Psychoactive Wellness Cannabinoid
content.description: CBD is a non-psychoactive cannabinoid known for its potential wellness benefits. It does not produce a "high" and is widely used for relaxation, stress relief, and general well-being.

steps.title: Consistent Use
steps.description: Take consistently for 2-3 weeks to assess benefits

steps.title: Adjust Dosage
steps.description: Adjust dosage based on your individual response

main_sections.title: Beginner's Guide: How to Choose
main_sections.subtitle: New to cannabinoids? Follow these steps to find the right product for you.

content.title: Step 1: Identify Your Goal
content.description: What are you looking for? Relaxation & Wellness: Start with CBD or low-dose Delta 9 gummies. Mild Euphoria: Try Delta 8 or Delta 9 (5-10mg). Strong Effects: THCA carts or THCA gummies. Maximum Potency: THCP (experienced users only)

content.title: Step 2: Choose Your Consumption Method
content.description: How do you prefer to consume? Gummies: Slower onset (1-2 hrs), longer duration (4-8 hrs), discreet. Vaping (Carts/Disposables): Fast onset (5-15 min), shorter duration (2-4 hrs), portable. Concentrates: Maximum potency, requires equipment, for experienced users

content.title: Step 3: Check Lab Results & Start Low
content.description: Safety and quality matter: Always verify the COA (Certificate of Analysis) on Binoid's site. Start with the lowest recommended dose. Wait at least 2 hours before taking more (for edibles). Keep track of how different products affect you

faq.question: Is Binoid Delta 9 legal?
faq.answer: Yes, hemp-derived Delta 9 THC is federally legal under the 2018 Farm Bill as long as it contains less than 0.3% THC by dry weight. However, state laws vary—check your local regulations before ordering.

faq.question: How long do effects last?
faq.answer: Gummies: 4-8 hours | Vaping: 2-4 hours | Concentrates: 2-6 hours (varies by individual)

faq.question: Are Binoid products third-party tested?
faq.answer: Yes, all Binoid products are third-party lab-tested for potency, purity, and safety. You can view the Certificate of Analysis (COA) for each product on the Binoid website.

faq.question: What's the difference between THCA and Delta 9?
faq.answer: THCA is the raw, non-psychoactive form of THC. When heated, it converts to Delta 9 THC. Delta 9 is the primary psychoactive compound. THCA products are often more potent and provide a different experience.

faq.question: How do I know which product is right for me?
faq.answer: Start by identifying your goal (relaxation, mild effects, or strong effects), choose your preferred consumption method, and always start with a low dose. Check the lab results and read reviews from other users.
